checks: The stationary probabilities are 2/3 in A and 1/3 in B.
Stationary probability flow is 1/6 in each direction.
Starting in A gives probabilities 1, 3/4 and 11/16.
The update contracts the gap from 2/3 by a factor of one quarter.
proof: The law of total probability gives p_next = 3p/4 + (1-p)/2 = 1/2 + p/4. Subtracting 2/3 yields p_next - 2/3 = (p - 2/3)/4. Repeated multiplication by one quarter tends to zero.
limits: The diagram shows probability mass, not exact population counts. A particular path is labeled separately. The limiting bar illustrates an approach, not finite-time attainment from p = 1. Not all Markov chains converge.
